description: Defines the DetailedMenuItem class used for representing menu items with properties such as id, title, module, screen, and child menu items, including methods for creation, accessors, mutators, and building from a MenuItem entity.

classes.name: DetailedMenuItem
classes.description: Represents a detailed menu item with properties such as id, title, associated module and screen, additional parameters, and potential child menu items. Includes methods for creation from a MenuItem object, accessors, mutators, and child management.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns additional parameters associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setAdditionalParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the menu item.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name for the menu item.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen URL or identifier.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen URL or identifier.

methods.name: createFromMenuItem
methods.description: Creates a DetailedMenuItem instance from a MenuItem entity, extracting relevant properties including module and screen details.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child menu item to the current menu item.

methods.name: getChildMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of child menu items.
